@graph.headline: Help Scout Review: Features, Limits and Fit
@graph.description: A source-based Help Scout review of its shared inbox, Docs, Beacon, workflows, AI costs and free-plan limits, with a clear view of who should use it now.

itemListElement.name: Help Scout Review: Features, Limits and Fit

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout is worth considering when a team wants a shared inbox, Docs and customer context in one support workspace. It is less suitable when the main need is a large ticket taxonomy, advanced routing or a self-hosted knowledge base.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout have a free plan?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The Free plan lists up to five users, one inbox, one Docs site and 100 contacts per month. Check the article and saved-reply limits before using it for a busy public support address.

mainEntity.name: How much does Help Scout cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pricing page displayed Standard at US$25, Plus at US$45 and Pro at US$75 per user/month on November 11, 2026. It has a monthly and annual selector, so confirm the billing mode and seat minimum before purchase.

mainEntity.name: Does Help Scout include an AI agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: The pricing page lists Envoy at US$0.75 per resolution. AI Inbox assistance and drafting features vary by plan. Confirm the current product label and resolution definition before estimating usage.

mainEntity.name: Can I migrate from another help desk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout lists supported import sources, including Freshdesk and Zendesk. The import does not recreate every user setting, knowledge article, saved reply, automation or custom field, so map those items separately.
